QLA25-L-1-PrivacyOfficer.reason: The notice provides a general contact email but does not designate or publish the title/contact of a Privacy Officer (person in charge of personal information protection).

QLA25-L-2-CollectionTransparency.evidence: If you would like to access the personal information we hold about you, you can email privacy@dataflowanalytics.example
QLA25-L-2-CollectionTransparency.reason: The notice provides an access route but does not inform individuals of rectification rights or the right to withdraw consent.

QLA25-L-3-PrivacyByDefault.evidence: By continuing to use our website, you agree to our use of cookies.
QLA25-L-3-PrivacyByDefault.reason: The notice implies tracking is enabled by default unless the user stops using the site, indicating opt‑in sharing rather than privacy‑protective default settings.

QLA25-L-4-PrivacyImpactAssessment.evidence: Some of these providers are located in other countries.
QLA25-L-4-PrivacyImpactAssessment.reason: The document indicates personal information may be communicated outside Québec but contains no mention of conducting a Privacy Impact Assessment (PIA).

QLA25-L-5-IncidentRegister.evidence: We protect your information using industry-standard measures and are committed to keeping your data safe.
QLA25-L-5-IncidentRegister.reason: The document discusses security generally but contains no statement about notifying the CAI and affected individuals after a serious confidentiality incident or maintaining a register of confidentiality incidents.

QLA25-L-6-ConsentCrossBorder.evidence: you consent to all of the data collection, use, and sharing described in this notice
QLA25-L-6-ConsentCrossBorder.reason: The notice relies on blanket bundled consent rather than specific, informed consent and provides no indication of a PIA or jurisdictional assessment for cross‑border data transfers.
